items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: This is Ben Amaroff. I'm looking for that picture.

ctx.x: Did you work any of the theaters with any other bands besides Forbes? Yeah, I worked at the, for Minsky, Harold Minsky, when they had a stage show. They didn't do too well with Burlesque or anything like that. So they put on, named bands would come in for a week and play at the St Charles Theater. St Charles Theater. That's right. It's torn down there. The International, Intercontinental. Intercontinental Hotel there. This is Ben Amaroff. I'm looking for that picture. Here's Gus Onry. You probably heard of him.…
